_comment: Driver catalog for nvidia-driver-support. The picker in install-nvidia-driver.sh reads this. `open_latest` is the newest N open-capable production drivers (newest first); `branches` pins one version per legacy series; `chip_map` maps an NVIDIA chip prefix (from lspci, e.g. GP107 -> GP) to a recommended branch. This file is regenerated daily by .github/workflows/check-drivers.yml — hand-edits to open_latest/branches[].version will be overwritten. Seed values below are all real, shipping driver versions.

latest.note: Newest open-module driver in open_latest (Turing and newer).

legacy-580.note: Last branch for Maxwell/Pascal/Volta. Security-only through Oct 2028. Open modules need Turing+, so proprietary.

legacy-470.note: Last branch for Kepler. Builds against modern 6.x kernels.

legacy-390.note: Last branch for Fermi. Does NOT cross-compile against TrueNAS 6.x kernels unpatched — bring a patched .run via --custom-run.

legacy-340.note: Last branch for Tesla G8x/G9x/GT2xx. Does NOT cross-compile against TrueNAS 6.x kernels unpatched — bring a patched .run via --custom-run.
